lcc_original: 拉麥對他的兩個妻子說：『亞大洗拉阿，聽我的話；拉麥的妻子阿，側耳聽我所說的：人傷了我，我把他殺了；少年人擊傷了我，我把他殺害；
unv_sn_reference: 拉麥<WH03929>對他兩個妻子<WAH09001><WH0802>說<WH0559><WTH8799>：亞大<WH05711>、洗拉<WH06741>，聽<WH08085><WTH8798>我的聲音<WH06963>；拉麥<WH03929>的妻子<WH0802>，細聽<WH0238><WTH8685>我的話語<WH0565>：{<WAH03588>}壯年人<WH0376>傷我<WAH09001><WH06482>，我把他殺了<WH02026><WTH8804>；少年人<WH03206>損我<WAH09001><WH02250>，我把他害了（或譯：我殺壯士卻傷自己，我害幼童卻損本身）。
notes: LCC writes 亞大洗拉阿 without comma between names; SN tags inserted after each name individually: 亞大<WH05711>洗拉<WH06741>阿
UNV 聲音<WH06963> (H6963 qol=voice) → LCC 話 (words/speech); semantic approximation, same SN attached to 話
UNV 細聽<WH0238><WTH8685> → LCC 側耳聽; both render H238 אָזַן (give ear); morphology WTH8685 attached to 聽
UNV 話語<WH0565> (H565 אִמְרָה=saying) → LCC 我所說的; LCC rephrases as relative clause; tag placed at phrase end
{<WAH03588>} retained: LCC has no explicit word for כִּי at this junction (colonic break used instead)
UNV 壯年人<WH0376> → LCC plain 人; LCC omits 壯年 qualifier but same root H376 אִישׁ
Hebrew לְפִצְעִי (for/of my wound, WAH09001+WH06482) rendered as UNV 傷我 and LCC 傷了我; tags placed after 我 in both
UNV 我把他害了 carries no SN (implied parallel with no second verb in Hebrew); LCC 我把他殺害 likewise left unannotated
